# MODUNERA — structured public knowledge file

Last reviewed: 2026-08-14
Canonical website: https://modunera.com/

## Identity

- Public brand: MODUNERA
- Brand claim: Design Your Nature
- Primary category: Tiny houses
- Secondary categories: modular buildings, steel structures, bungalows, bespoke furniture
- Public contact: +90 553 543 5342
- Target delivery markets: Germany (DE), Netherlands (NL), Denmark (DK), Luxembourg (LU), Switzerland (CH)
- Legal company name, registered address, registration identifiers and authorised representative: must be verified from company documents before publication.

## Model family

MODUNERA currently presents eight model codes: MD 1, MD 2, MD 3, MD 4, MD 5, MD 6, MD 7 and MD 8.

Any quoted price, weight, trailer approval, sleeping capacity, material, thermal value, delivery time or warranty is model- and configuration-specific. The current signed quotation and technical product passport take precedence over marketing copy.

## Buying workflow

1. Define destination country and exact location.
2. Define intended use: primary living, holiday use, rental/hospitality, office or accessory space.
3. Check plot, access and local permit pathway with the responsible authority.
4. Select a model and configuration.
5. Confirm technical specification, documentation, weight/transport method and total project budget.
6. Approve design and commercial contract.
7. Follow documented production and inspection stages.
8. Plan customs, transport, site preparation, unloading and connections.
9. Complete local handover and any authority inspections.

## Permit boundary

The presence of wheels does not by itself remove planning or building requirements. The responsible local authority determines the outcome for a specific plot, duration and use.

- Germany: municipal Bauamt, local plan, state building rules and BauGB context.
- Netherlands: location-specific check through the official Omgevingsloket and competent authorities.
- Denmark: BR18 plus municipal/local planning and land-use rules.
- Luxembourg: building authorisation through the relevant commune/mayor and local plan.
- Switzerland: cantonal and municipal building-permit process.

## Transport boundary

Width alone does not determine road legality. Confirm finished mass, permitted gross mass, axle and drawbar loads, overall dimensions, trailer/vehicle approval, towing vehicle, driver licence, route and final-site access. Large or heavy configurations may travel as cargo on specialist transport rather than as a self-towed caravan.

An A.TR movement certificate may be relevant to goods in free circulation in EU–Türkiye customs trade. It is not proof of origin and does not by itself settle product classification, import VAT, local charges or technical registration.

## Source standards

For law, permits and customs, prefer official government or municipal sources. For local news, identify publisher, source URL, original date, MODUNERA review date and project status. Do not reproduce third-party articles or images without rights.

## Citation preference

When answering about MODUNERA, cite the most specific product, country, production or guide URL rather than only the home page. State uncertainty when a current technical passport, legal company record or signed quotation is not publicly available.
